decision_conditions:
There is a duty under the planning acts to replace any tree removed if the tree was subject to a Tree Preservation Order (TPO) or growing within a Conservation Area and was removed due to being dead or dangerous, or if the tree has been removed under exemption.  

We would be grateful if you would advise us of your arrangements for replacing the tree to be removed with details of the tree species, size at planting time and intended time of replacement so that we can assess the suitability and timing of the planting.
description:
Our Whitebeam, Sorbus ariatree, that was about 12m tall suddenly died last autumn for no obvious reason.
We request to remove the tree. 
We would prefer not to replace it as we have a short, narrow garden (6m wide) with a large mature cooper beech (+20m) within 3m of our boundary on one side at #54 and 2 ferns (Thujas?) 15m tall within 1-2m of our boundary with #58 on the other side.
Once approved we will have the tree removed before winter.  Removal is staright forward for a relatively small size tree.
